Women in Geku, Arunachal Pradesh’s Upper Siang district, have emerged as prominent voices against the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. They fear the dam will submerge their ancestral land, destroy livelihoods and threaten their culture. On 23 October, women also staged a semi-nude protest at a police barricade during a bandh against the project.
